name: Portal Time Machine
description: Replace the narrow per-execution rollback in DataRefresh with a portal-wide Time Machine: given a target date, restore every portal data source (yang pipeline, BD pipeline, news/trending) to its state as of 5:00 PM ET on that date. Research phase first — AE audit required to confirm S3 versioning status, BD snapshot feasibility, and DynamoDB scope before implementation.
phase: DEPLOYED -- awaiting acceptance testing. All layers live. Gated on first BD manifest (tonight's nightly run ~23:00 UTC) before Layer 2 acceptance test.
blocking: nightly BD gold run (23:00 UTC) -- first bd-capture-output-versions manifest needed for Test 2a

known_limitations.fallback_path_timeout: bd-time-machine fallback (pre-manifest dates) times out on gold/clients/ volume (~thousands of files, 300s limit). Manifest path unaffected. Pre-manifest dates not restorable via bd-time-machine until fallback is redesigned.
known_limitations.fred_cache: cache/fred/ not captured or restored. Accepted exception for Phase 1.
known_limitations.bd_earliest_manifest_date: First manifest written after 2026-03-10 nightly run. Pre-manifest BD restore unsupported.
known_limitations.dynamo_market_overview_coverage: DAILY# items available from yang pipeline start date. Gaps logged as warnings, S3 restore still proceeds.

cli_findings_2026_03_10.prd_snapshot_approach: SUPERSEDED -- opal-data-bd versioning already on; use version-restore not snapshot archive
